title: runHistory
responsibility: Attaches a stored record to Git history and reports what history proves about a commit.

inputs.name: sourceCommit.root
inputs.description: Repository path passed to GitAdapter for the revision lookup. It must identify a Git repository.

inputs.name: sourceCommit.reference
inputs.description: Git revision expression resolved as <reference>^{commit} in that repository. It must name a commit, and the default is HEAD.

inputs.name: historyAttach.options
inputs.description: Options select the repository root, source commit, and verification record to attach. Omitted root uses process.cwd(), omitted commit resolves as HEAD, and omitted record selects the latest stored record for that commit.

inputs.name: historyStatus.options
inputs.description: Options select the repository root and source commit for the Git-history status query. Omitted root uses process.cwd() and omitted commit resolves as HEAD; record is accepted by the shared options type but is not used here.

inputs.name: renderStatus.status
inputs.description: Git-history result for one source commit, including its verification records and problems. verified is true only when an attached record passed and is valid after its record, files, and lineage are checked.

outputs.name: sourceCommit
outputs.description: Full commit hash resolved from the requested reference in the repository. Resolution rejects if root is not a Git repository or the reference does not name a commit.

outputs.name: historyAttach
outputs.description: Details of the verification record attached to the source commit, including its evidence pointer, notes ref, archive ref, and whether this call created it. created is false when the exact record was already attached, and attachment can reject when the record is missing or invalid.

outputs.name: historyStatus
outputs.description: Git-history result for one full source commit, with attached verification records and problems. verified is true only when an attached record has status passed and is valid after its record, files, and lineage are checked.

outputs.name: renderStatus
outputs.description: Human-readable newline-separated summary produced from CommitStatus. Each record line shows the first 12 characters of its record id, its status, and (not usable) when valid is false.
examples:
Commit 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567 is verified by Git history: 1 attached record.
  verify-20261 passed

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when the source repository or revision is invalid, or when a selected verification record cannot be found or attached. Its message carries the specific failure reason.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when source resolution fails, no matching verification record exists, or the selected record cannot be attached because its integrity, dependencies, or archive step fails. The message identifies the failure reason.
